quests.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 5

dialogue.t: Honorary Knight! I didn't expect to run into you here!
Yes! I finally got the chance to come here on vacation, and I wanted to bring a few gifts back for the Knights of Favonius.
I heard that, during Lantern Rite, locals like to include one of these envelopes with their gifts.
So, I wanted to follow their lead and make a few gift envelopes of my own. But, they're not looking too good...
I want my gift envelopes to be beautiful! Can you show me how, Honorary Knight?

dialogue.sit: Of course, leave it to me.

dialogue.t: I want my gift envelopes to be beautiful! Can you show me how, Honorary Knight?

dialogue.sit: Of course, leave it to me.

dialogue.t: So, that's how it works... Wow, is there anything you can't do?
Thank you for teaching me. I'll treasure this gift envelope!
Be sure to stop by the next Windblume Festival, okay?
When that day comes, I'll make you a gift envelope just as beautiful as this one.

quests.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope…
